sceneRouting.rootCause: Runtime demo scenes did not guarantee three distinct live media streams. A scene with an inactive camera/screen source could resolve metadata while the monitor had no scene-owned stream, and earlier behavior could appear as stale media. The resolver now prefers the selected scene's active visible stream and generated demo test-pattern streams provide unique A/B/C media without camera permissions.
sceneRouting.programResolvedSourceRule: selected Program scene -> visible unlocked camera/screen/media sources sorted by z-index/order -> first active source stream, otherwise first eligible inactive source with null stream
sceneRouting.previewResolvedSourceRule: selected Preview scene -> visible unlocked camera/screen/media sources sorted by z-index/order -> first active source stream, otherwise first eligible inactive source with null stream

nativeRecordingUi.rootCause: The default Director production workspace did not include the registered recording panel in visiblePanels, so Native Recording existed in the registry/menu path but was not visible in the tested default Control Room workspace.
